composite_grain_uniqueness.contract: Each engine-cycle snapshot (unit_number, time_in_cycles) must be strictly unique.

engine_unit_contiguity.contract: Engine identifiers must be strictly contiguous integers from 1 to N.

cycle_sequence_continuity.contract: Trajectories must start at cycle 1 and increment monotonically by +1 with zero missing cycles.

sensor_variance_audit.contract: Audit sensor columns for within-dataset variation under the evaluated flight regime.
sensor_variance_audit.interpretation: Identified channels exhibit zero within-dataset variation under FD001 and cannot distinguish degradation progression in this analysis.

trajectory_lifespan_bounds.contract: Run-to-failure lifespans fall within expected simulation bounds [50, 1000] cycles.

test_rul_alignment.contract: Ground truth RUL vector length must exactly match the number of unique test engines.
test_rul_alignment.reconciliation_note: In FD004, a documentation/file-count discrepancy was identified during programmatic validation (readme claims 248 train / 249 test; actual files contain 249 train / 248 test).

operational_decision_context.contract: Verify whether validated operational maintenance thresholds, economic costs, or real-world failure probabilities exist in the dataset.
operational_decision_context.maintenance_cost_matrix: UNKNOWN (Economic data not included in simulation)
operational_decision_context.governance_implication: All analytical thresholds (e.g., RUL <= 30) must be treated as unratified exploratory boundaries, not operational maintenance policies.
